notes: SIMD Launchpad preset test launch on Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). Token: SIMDTEST, a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 (1,000,000,000 units, 18 decimals, no constructor arguments) that mints the whole supply to its deployer and has no owner, mint, burn, pause, tax or transfer restriction. Hook: SIMDTESTHook, constructor (IPoolManager manager, address token, address factory) -> $poolManager (0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 on mainnet), $token (the SIMDTEST deployed just before it) and $factory (the launch factory). The hook has no owner, setters, selfdestruct, delegatecall or upgrade path; every address is immutable or a compile-time constant. Pool: SIMDTEST/IMD (IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7), static LP fee 12500 (1.25%), tickSpacing 60; the hook's beforeInitialize accepts only this exact key with this fee and spacing, only when called by the PoolManager with $factory as the initializing sender, and only once. It records the opening block; the required address flags are 0x28cc (beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta). initialPrice is provenance only; the factory sets the opening sqrtPriceX96 from the launch economics. Fee mechanics run in swap callbacks and are denominated in IMD, on top of the 1.25% LP fee: (1) anti-snipe fee for the first 10 blocks after initialization, 30% in the opening block declining linearly by 3 percentage points per block to 0% from block +10, donated to the pool's in-range liquidity via PoolManager.donate inside the same swap (if the swap leaves no in-range liquidity, that amount goes to the treasury instead so the swap does not fail); (2) fixed 0.5% treasury fee on every swap to 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985, transferred out of the PoolManager during the swap when the manager holds enough IMD, otherwise held as the hook's ERC-6909 claim (pendingTreasury()) and paid by the next swap or by anyone calling the permissionless payTreasury(). Fees are taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas; the hook never overrides the LP fee. Partial fills of a specified IMD amount revert atomically rather than charging a fee on unexecuted input. beforeAddLiquidity: while the anti-snipe fee is nonzero (blocks +0 to +9) only $factory, or any caller inside the initializing transaction, may add liquidity, so donations reach the seeded launch position rather than just-in-time positions; removals are never restricted and provision is open to everyone afterwards. The seeded liquidity should therefore be added by $factory or within the initialize transaction. Donated anti-snipe fees accrue as fee growth to the in-range launch position; its owner collects them normally. No paired token is ever burned. Supply allocation (burn, pool seed, swarm) and the 1% creator fee are handled by the launch policy and fee splitter outside this hook. Tests (test/) deploy the real v4 PoolManager locally and cover the decay schedule, donation accounting, treasury payment and deferral, liquidity lock, plain transfers and the absence of privileged functions.
